title: Nemzeti ébredés és a magyar nyelv mozgalma (A Country Recovering)
grammar: Postpositions of Instrumentality (által, révén) and Enlightened Reforms

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can tell how the movement for the Hungarian language grew in the late 18th century.
I can use verbs such as felvirágzik and megerősít to describe cultural change.
I can name György Bessenyei and the first Hungarian-language newspaper.
I can use eight new words about the national awakening.
